subject: LangGraph Studio
item: **May a flow be started from inside LangGraph Studio, or only from `golem_runtime run`?** Measured and not in dispute: Studio can start a run. What our runs depend on and a Studio-started run would not get: the gate channel that reaches Telegram through the runtime's own bot, the cron keepalive that resurrects a dead run, and a run id that keys the record and the effect log. If the answer is that Studio should be able to start runs, those three have to stop being properties of whoever launched the run.

subject: FreeCAD lives in two places
item: FreeCAD is installed INTO the CAD container image although the host already has one, and that is a deliberate duplicate, not an oversight. Measured why a copy was impossible: the host's FreeCAD is a conda environment under `/root`, unreadable to `golem-runtime`, and `Bash` in the runtime runs through `containers.run`, so a host binary is invisible to an agent whatever its permissions. One of the two goes at the end of the build - most likely the host's, since the runtime is what will still be running.
